name: Quick Start
author: Brandon
description:
Developer quality-of-life keys.

F10 - QUICK RELOAD: reboots the game and loads you straight back into your current save, no menus. Uses the game's own db_load boot parameter. If you quicksaved (F5) this session, F10 prefers the quicksave slot, so F5 then F10 loses zero progress.

Standalone and save-safe: registers no elements, changes no gameplay.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the F10 quick-reload key off without unsubscribing.
